# gitmoap_repository_pipeline_variables (Data Source)

List the variables that apply to a repository's pipelines. Returns the effective set, ordered by name: the repository's own variables and those of every group above it, the nearest declaration of a name winning, each naming the scope it came from and whether it shadows a farther one. A secret's value is never returned. Reporters and above may read them; variables are not public, even on a public repository.

The token needs `pipeline_variable:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_pipeline_variables" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) The repository's id

### Read-Only

- `max_value_bytes` (Number) The longest value a variable may hold, in bytes.
- `variables` (Attributes List) The variables that apply, each naming the scope that declared it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether only a run on a protected branch or tag receives the variable. A run on any other
ref receives neither this value nor a value the same name has further up.
- `secret` (Boolean)
- `shadowed` (Boolean) `true` when a group further up also declares this name, so removing this declaration would
uncover that one rather than remove the variable.
- `source` (Attributes) The group or repository that declared a variable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables--source))
- `value` (String, Sensitive)

<a id="nestedatt--variables--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables.source`

Read-Only:

- `full_path` (String) The full path of the group or repository that declared the variable (e.g. `acme/platform`
or `acme/platform/api`).
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
